tools.name: bib:get
tools.description: Retrieve a single bibliography entry by ID. Returns the full YAML block.

file.description: Absolute path to the CSL-YAML bibliography file (required). Look for "bibliography:" in pandoc.yaml or the YAML frontmatter of .md files.

tools.name: bib:search
tools.description: Search bibliography entries across all fields: author, title, type, year, editor, container-title. Use ONE search term per call (e.g., "Pahlow" or "OLG Köln"). For multiple lookups, call this tool multiple times.

file.description: Absolute path to the CSL-YAML bibliography file (required). Look for "bibliography:" in pandoc.yaml or the YAML frontmatter of .md files.

query.description: Single search term (case-insensitive, matches any field). Do NOT combine multiple terms — use separate calls instead.

tools.name: bib:list
tools.description: List all bibliography entries of a given CSL type (e.g., "legal_case", "book", "article-journal", "chapter").

file.description: Absolute path to the CSL-YAML bibliography file (required). Look for "bibliography:" in pandoc.yaml or the YAML frontmatter of .md files.

tools.name: bib:exists
tools.description: Check if a citation ID exists in the bibliography. Fast boolean check before citing.

file.description: Absolute path to the CSL-YAML bibliography file (required). Look for "bibliography:" in pandoc.yaml or the YAML frontmatter of .md files.

tools.name: bib:stats
tools.description: Get bibliography statistics: total entry count and breakdown by CSL type.

file.description: Absolute path to the CSL-YAML bibliography file (required). Look for "bibliography:" in pandoc.yaml or the YAML frontmatter of .md files.

tools.name: bib:add
tools.description: Add a new bibliography entry. Validates required fields per CSL type, checks for duplicate IDs, and creates a .bak backup before writing. Returns the created YAML block for confirmation.

file.description: Absolute path to the CSL-YAML bibliography file (required). Look for "bibliography:" in pandoc.yaml or the YAML frontmatter of .md files.

style.description: Optional path to a CSL style file (.csl). Enables style-aware required-field validation.

tools.name: bib:update
tools.description: Update fields of an existing bibliography entry. Only the specified fields are changed; all other fields remain untouched. Creates a .bak backup before writing.

file.description: Absolute path to the CSL-YAML bibliography file (required). Look for "bibliography:" in pandoc.yaml or the YAML frontmatter of .md files.

style.description: Optional path to a CSL style file (.csl). Enables style-aware required-field validation.

tools.name: bib:delete
tools.description: Remove a bibliography entry by ID. Creates a .bak backup before writing.

file.description: Absolute path to the CSL-YAML bibliography file (required). Look for "bibliography:" in pandoc.yaml or the YAML frontmatter of .md files.

tools.name: bib:validate
tools.description: Validate the entire bibliography file: YAML syntax, required fields per CSL type, duplicate IDs, and missing issued dates. Returns a list of errors and warnings.

file.description: Absolute path to the CSL-YAML bibliography file (required). Look for "bibliography:" in pandoc.yaml or the YAML frontmatter of .md files.

style.description: Optional path to a CSL style file (.csl). Enables style-aware required-field validation.

tools.name: ctverify:extract
tools.description: Extract citations from Pandoc inline footnotes (^[...]) for verification tracking. This is a CITATION VERIFICATION tool, not bibliography management. It extracts citations so the LLM can systematically verify that each cited source actually supports the claim made in the text. Use `registry_path` to save/merge results into a JSON registry file (preserves existing claims and statuses). Re-running after text edits is safe: exact cite matches preserve claims/status, proximity matching (±5 lines) recovers claims when cite text changed. Each citation captures ~200 chars of surrounding context for claim formulation. Workflow: extract → set claims → verify each claim against the source using research tools → update status.

file.description: Single path or array of paths to Markdown files to extract citations from

registry_path.description: Path to the citation registry JSON file (required). Set DT_CT_REGISTRY env var to make optional.

dry_run.description: Preview merge result without writing. Use after text edits to check which citations are new, removed, or proximity-matched before committing.

tools.name: ctverify:update
tools.description: Batch update citation verification entries. Each entry can set claim, status, and/or note independently. The `claim` field records WHAT the text asserts at this citation point. The `status` tracks verification progress: pending → under_review → verified/disputed/not_found. If an ID does not exist and `cite` is provided, creates a new entry (for inline citations not in footnotes).

registry_path.description: Path to the citation registry JSON file (required). Set DT_CT_REGISTRY env var to make optional.

cite.description: Raw citation text (required when adding a new entry)

line.description: Line number in source file (for new entries)

claim.description: What the text asserts at this citation

tools.name: ctverify:status
tools.description: Show verification progress of a citation registry: counts by status and list of citations. Use `filter_status` to focus on specific statuses, `filter_claim` to search claims or find missing ones.

registry_path.description: Path to the citation registry JSON file (required). Set DT_CT_REGISTRY env var to make optional.

filter_status.description: Only show citations with this status

filter_claim.description: Filter by claim: use "" for entries without claims, or any text to search within claims

file.description: Only show citations from this source file (matches basename or path suffix, e.g. "40-02.md")

ids.description: Only show these specific citation IDs

tools.name: ctverify:get
tools.description: Retrieve one or more citation entries by ID. Returns full details including cite, context, claim, status, and note.

registry_path.description: Path to the citation registry JSON file (required). Set DT_CT_REGISTRY env var to make optional.

tools.name: ctverify:bulk-update
tools.description: Update status (and optionally note) for multiple citations at once. Select entries either by a list of IDs or by filter (current status). At least one of `ids` or `filter_status` must be provided.

registry_path.description: Path to the citation registry JSON file (required). Set DT_CT_REGISTRY env var to make optional.

ids.description: List of citation IDs to update

filter_status.description: Update all entries with this current status

note.description: Note to set on all matched entries
